plugins.name: review-anvil
plugins.description: Iterative multi-agent code review with six skills: review-anvil, review-anvil-readonly, review-anvil-pr, review-anvil-improve-pr, review-anvil-init, and review-anvil-rules. Includes private per-repository feedback memory and automatic source-backed local rule activation, with no rule branches or proposal PRs. Base-side policy takes precedence. PR pilot runs are comment-only and support no-post comparisons that still learn locally. Distinct reviewer lenses, batched reproduction, adversarial review, and build/test gates support review and optional fix workflows.

plugins.name: overleaf-comment

plugins.name: overleaf-compile
plugins.description: Recompile an Overleaf project and extract its build logs/errors/warnings in a standardized format via Chrome DevTools Protocol. Uses the chrome-cdp skill to drive an existing logged-in browser tab.

plugins.name: gdocs-comment

plugins.name: gh-pr-image
